mentions.name: MOOLLM
mentions.description: A microworld operating system that treats the LLM as eval(), built on top of Anthropic's Skills framework with seven extensions: skill instantiation with per-instance state, K-line semantic activation names, empathic templates, three-tier persistence (platform/narrative/state), batching many turns into one call, machine-readable CARD.yml skill interfaces, and semantically meaningful comments that the model interprets. Instead of prompt engineering, the LLM inhabits a persistent github-repo filesystem microworld where characters keep state in directories and can reflect on and edit themselves; everything is inspectable and editable by both human and model, and it is model- and platform-independent (runs on Cursor and other tools/orchestrators). Includes a 150+ file text adventure example with 6000+ lines of session transcripts and 79 Anthropic-compatible skills.
mentions.source_excerpt:
MOOLLM -- treating the LLM as eval() for a microworld operating system.

Started this incarnation on Dec 30, 2025 -- but it's the crystallization of decades of earlier prototypes, all the way back to my Commodore-64 Logo Adventure. Built on top of Anthropic's Skills framework, extended with seven innovations (and counting):
